tools.name: create_carousel
tools.description: Create a branded carousel and temporary PDF from a public URL or text.

source.description: Source text; at least 40 printable non-whitespace characters. Or a public HTTP(S) URL. Text cap: 1800 UTF-8 bytes; URL cap: 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

title.description: Optional title, allowed only with text.

n.description: Signed decimal integer n is clamped to 6..8; non-integer n defaults to 6. The response reports effective n.
